title: One invoice class with two ordered rate JARs
summary: Reversing two JARs with the same Rate class changes four nonzero invoices and preserves zero.

change.description: Reversing two JARs with the same Rate class changes four nonzero invoices and preserves zero.

notes: Swapping the two dependency JARs changes four of the five invoice totals. Both JAR sets and the Invoice class digest are identical. The zero input returns zero under both orders. A fresh JVM records the selected Rate code source and class digest. Ingestion rejects the opposite order.
The two absolute rate claims distinguish a checker loading the wrong helper from an actual preservation result.
